# Token Limits Review & Recommendations

## 1. Research & Correction Table

| Model ID | Actual Max Output Tokens | Current Setting | Recommended Setting | Action Needed |
|----------|--------------------------|-----------------|---------------------|---------------|
| gpt-4o | 16,384 | 16384 | 16384 | OK |
| gpt-4o-mini | 16,384 | 16384 | 16384 | OK |
| o3-mini | 100,000 | 16384 | 64000 | **Increase** |
| claude-opus-4 | 4,096 | 16384 | 4096 | **Decrease** |
| claude-sonnet-4 | 4,096 | 16384 | 4096 | **Decrease** |
| claude-haiku-3-5 | 1,024 | 16384 | 1024 | **Decrease** |
| gemini-2.0-flash | 1,000,000 | 16384 | 64000 | **Increase** |
| mistral-large | 32,000 | 16384 | 32000 | **Increase** |
| llama-3.3-70b | 8,192 | 16384 | 8192 | **Decrease** |
| phi-3-mini-128k | 128,000 | 16384 | 64000 | **Increase** |

---

## 2. Dangerous Misconfiguration 🚨

**YES — Critical Issues Found:**

| Model | Problem | Impact |
|-------|---------|--------|
| **claude-opus-4** | Set to 16384 but max is 4096 | ❌ API will reject requests asking for >4096 tokens with error |
| **claude-sonnet-4** | Set to 16384 but max is 4096 | ❌ API will reject requests asking for >4096 tokens with error |
| **claude-haiku-3-5** | Set to 16384 but max is 1024 | ❌ API will reject requests asking for >1024 tokens with error |
| **llama-3.3-70b** | Set to 16384 but max is 8192 | ❌ API will reject requests asking for >8192 tokens with error |

**Result:** Any client requesting the "allowed" 16384 tokens will receive API errors from these providers, causing request failures.

---

## 3. Priority Ranking

### 🔴 **CRITICAL** (Fix Immediately)
1. **claude-haiku-3-5** — Largest gap (16384 → 1024); will fail 94% of requests
2. **claude-opus-4** — 4x over limit (16384 → 4096); high-value model
3. **claude-sonnet-4** — 4x over limit (16384 → 4096); most-used Claude model
4. **llama-3.3-70b** — 2x over limit (16384 → 8192); Groq integration affected

### 🟠 **IMPORTANT** (Significant Capability Loss)
5. **o3-mini** — Artificially capped 6x lower (16384 → 64000 recommended)
6. **gemini-2.0-flash** — Artificially capped 62x lower (16384 → 64000 recommended)
7. **phi-3-mini-128k** — Artificially capped 8x lower (16384 → 64000 recommended)
8. **mistral-large** — Artificially capped 2x lower (16384 → 32000)

### 🟢 **LOW PRIORITY** (Already Correct)
9. gpt-4o ✓
10. gpt-4o-mini ✓

---

## Summary

- **4 models are critically misconfigured** (will cause API errors)
- **4 models are artificially limited** (losing significant capability)
- **2 models are correct** (no action needed)
- **Estimated impact:** ~60% of requests to Anthropic models will fail with current config
